newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: SOCCER-CAF HEAD HAPPY WITH AFRICAN NATIONS CUP PREPARATIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAF HEAD HAPPY WITH AFRICAN NATIONS CUP PREPARATIONS.

text.p: The head of the Confederation of African Football (CAF), Issa Hayatou, said on Thursday that he was happy with Burkina Faso's preparations for hosting the 1998 African Nations Cup finals and expected everything to be ready on time.

Hayatou told a news conference at the end of a visit to inspect the facilities that he found both political will and widespread enthusiasm at all levels to ensure that the competition next February would be a success.
"We found the results very positive and we are proud to say so. If things continue at this rhythm we are convinced that everything will be ready by the end of 1997," he said.

Hayatou played down suggestions that he might run for election as president of FIFA, the game's world body, when Joao Havelange retires after the 1998 World Cup finals although he did not rule out the possibility.
"I don't know if I will stand. Everything will depend on the circumstances but at present I am not a candidate," he said.
The five-member CAF inspection team visited the key sporting and hotel sites in Ouagadougou and the second city of Bobo-Dioulasso, the two venues for the competition.
